name: voice-ai-pipecat
description: Voice AI assistant with a local MAX-served LLM: Pipecat + max serve (OpenAI-compatible) + local faster-whisper STT + Piper TTS

variables.name: MAX_MODEL
variables.description: Hugging Face model repo served by MAX as the local LLM (bf16 safetensors for GPU hosts; FP32-native models for CPU-only hosts)

variables.name: HF_TOKEN
variables.description: Optional Hugging Face token for gated models (e.g. Llama)

variables.name: GOOGLE_API_KEY
variables.description: Optional API key for Gemini (aistudio.google.com) — the default LLM is local via MAX, so cloud providers are opt-in from the settings drawer

variables.name: AUDIO_INPUT_DEVICE
variables.description: PyAudio input device index for the local mic, or 'default'. main.py logs the enumeration on startup so you can pick the right index for your USB mic.

variables.name: AUDIO_OUTPUT_DEVICE
variables.description: PyAudio output device index for the local speaker, or 'default'.

variables.name: WAKE_WORD_MODELS
variables.description: Comma-separated openWakeWord models to listen for. Pretrained options: alexa, hey_jarvis, hey_mycroft, hey_rhasspy, ok_nabu. Custom 'Hey Wendy' requires training a model.

variables.name: WAKE_WORD_THRESHOLD
variables.description: Detection confidence (0.0 to 1.0). Lower = more sensitive but more false triggers.

variables.name: WAKE_LISTEN_SECS
variables.description: Max seconds to keep the mic open after the wake word fires before auto-closing.

variables.name: LOG_TRANSCRIPTS
variables.description: Log per-turn STT transcripts and TTS responses to stdout. Default false to keep private speech out of production logs (latency/character-count telemetry stays on regardless). Set true for local debugging — useful for verifying what the bot heard vs what it said.
